purpose: Small, restrained sound accents supporting the explanation.
selection_rules: Start with no effect; add only for a specific editorial purpose.
Judge level against the narrator, not a fixed universal dB value.
Avoid layering multiple accents for one event.
Do not place sounds on every cut, caption phrase or word.

categories.character: Soft, short tonal tick or muted chime
categories.use: A key clarification or resolved contradiction

categories.character: Quiet dry tap or muted click
categories.use: A meaningful term or single visual emphasis
A purposeful diagram or visual transition
categories.avoid: Loud sweeping whooshes on narrator jump cuts

categories.character: Subtle contextual sound linked to an explanatory example
categories.use: When it improves comprehension of the analogy
categories.avoid: Comic stings that distract from the explanation

note: Categories are proposed for review. No recordings have been selected, generated, licensed or approved. Never report an effect applied without a real asset and edit.
